edits.location: What does a travel advisor actually do?, paragraph 1
edits.issue: Advisor scope extends to guest accommodation and ground transport between venues (transfers), beyond fact_26 (venue, travel, vendors and payments)
edits.old: accommodation for you and your guests, transport between them and the suppliers who make the day work
edits.new: travel for you and your guests, and the suppliers who make the day work

edits.location: Six ways: Both sets of terms, read before you pay
edits.issue: Asserts an advisor capability (walking couples through terms) not in fact_22 to fact_26; fact_05/fact_06 only support that both sets apply and should be checked in writing
edits.fix: Replace old with new (marker after it kept).
edits.old: A good advisor walks you through both sets before you book, and confirms anything unclear in writing.
edits.new: Ask any advisor to show you both sets before you book, and to confirm anything unclear in writing.

edits.location: Six ways: Quotes in Australian dollars, paragraph 1
edits.issue: 'rarely' overstates fact_19/fact_20, which say providers set their own rate and fees and the advertised rate may not be the rate you get
edits.old: and the number you see is rarely the number that leaves your account
edits.new: and the number you see may not be the number that leaves your account

edits.location: FAQ: What does a travel advisor do?
edits.issue: Guest accommodation as advisor scope goes beyond fact_26
edits.old: that can extend to the venue, guest accommodation and suppliers
edits.new: that can extend to the venue, travel and suppliers
